# AXM Workshop

> Public experimental local-first workshop where people and optional AI collaborators can build, play, inspect, learn, and create without surrendering their files or authority.

Primary website: https://mike-axiom-mir.github.io/axm-collaboration-platform/
Source repository: https://github.com/mike-axiom-mir/axm-collaboration-platform
Current reviewed release: https://github.com/mike-axiom-mir/axm-collaboration-platform/releases/tag/v0.7.0-experimental

## What it is

AXM Workshop is a modular, local-first environment for creative work, games, projects, research, verification, and bounded human-machine collaboration. The public browser doorway is a small temporary workroom; the full Workshop is designed to run on the user's own device.

## Truth boundary

AXM is experimental and is not claimed to be production-certified. The repository is publicly inspectable but currently does not grant a broad open-source license. Warnings, incomplete boundaries, and unproven claims should remain visible rather than being silently upgraded.
